name: Pesquera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pesquera (a column, a wheel, an anvil and a book).
history: Municipal flag of Pesquera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pesquera arms — column, wheel, anvil and book
